title: refactor(plugin-security): move the organization-scope helpers and the seed write-refusal accumulator out of per-organization-catalog.ts
body:
Part of #15204

Clause-②: no

Stage **6c-prep** of the cutover stage plan (claim amendment 6098235618 on the card, adding this stage to the epic lane's claim 6095611212). The surviving per-organization helpers leave `per-organization-catalog.ts`, so stage 6c (deleting that module) no longer waits on stage 7. This is a move with no behavior change. #15204 remains open: this PR is one stage of its cutover.

## What moved, and where

`sec/` = `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/`.

| Export | New home | Kept consumers past 6c's landing slot |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `seedCtx`, `catalogIsPerOrganization`, `listSeedOrganizationIds`, `rowOrganizationId`, `resolveOwnOrganizationRow`, `SEED_ORGANIZATION_SCAN_LIMIT`, `warnOrganizationLessRows`, `OrganizationLessRowOrigin` | `sec/organization-scope.ts` | delegated-admin-gate, grant-permission-set-name-backfill, auto-org-admin-grant, security-plugin, bootstrap-declared-permissions (6b-2), seed-name-lookup and permission-set-projection (7a) |
| `SeedLogger`, `logSeedDurabilityFailure`, `createSeedWriteRefusals`, `reportSeedWriteRefusals`, `SeedWriteRefusals`, `SeedWriteRefusalReport`, `SeedWriteRefusalClass` | `sec/write-refusals.ts` | bootstrap-platform-admin, cleanup-package-permissions, suggested-audience-bindings, bootstrap-declared-permissions and permission-set-drift (6b-2), permission-set-overlay-discard (7-pre), permission-set-projection (7a) |

- **What stays in `per-organization-catalog.ts`:** `rowMatchesDeclaration` and nothing else. Its one importer is `bootstrap-builtin-positions.ts`, which retires in 6a. The module changes by deletion only: `git diff` shows 0 added lines and 666 deleted.
- **Bodies are byte-identical.** Each new module is built from line ranges of the old file. Each gets a new header of at most seven lines, plus one new `import type { SeedLogger } from './write-refusals.js'` in `organization-scope.ts`. No export is renamed, and no signature or body changes.
- **The doctrine docblock moved with the helpers it explains.** Its three sections (why the catalog is per organization, the doctrine, and what replaces a reap) now head `organization-scope.ts`, beside `resolveOwnOrganizationRow` and `warnOrganizationLessRows`.
- **The `SeedLogger` choice.** Both modules use `SeedLogger`. It lives in `write-refusals.ts` because its own doc is the durability-channel contract, and `organization-scope.ts` imports the type from there. Its pin in `seed-write-refusal.test.ts` reads the declaration from source, so that test's path literal follows it.
- **No re-export shim, and no public surface.** None of these names is in `plugin-security`'s `src/index.ts`, and none is imported from any other package (`git grep` over the tree). The package's public exports are unchanged.

## Importers repointed

There are 17 importers in `sec/` plus `seed-write-refusal.test.ts`. The only edits are their import specifiers: names, aliases (`seedCtx as organizationScopedCtx`, `seedCtx as lookupCtx`) and `type` modifiers are all kept. `walled-platform-bucket-diagnostic.test.ts` names the module only in comments, which point at `per-organization-catalog.test.ts`, so it is unchanged.

For retired modules, batch #310 item 4 applies as the seat reads it in 6098235618: an import specifier repoint is the mechanical consequence of the move, and no other line changes. That covers the 6a, 6b-1, 6b-2, 7-pre and 7a modules. `permission-set-projection.ts`'s import is the only line changed there.

## Comment pointers

- **Repointed in surviving modules:**
  - `security-plugin.ts`, the seeding comment: now `organization-scope.ts`, plus `rowMatchesDeclaration` for the O(changed declarations) half.
  - `delegated-admin-gate.ts`: now `organization-scope.ts`.
  - `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts`, the `tryInsert` comment: now `write-refusals.ts`.
  - `plugin-auth/src/ensure-default-organization.ts`, the `logSeedDurabilityFailure` provenance: now `write-refusals.ts`. Comment only.
- **Left as they are in retired modules (item 4):** `bootstrap-builtin-positions.ts`, `bootstrap-declared-positions.ts`, `bootstrap-declared-permissions.ts`, `permission-set-projection.ts`, and `plugin-sharing/src/bootstrap-declared-sharing-rules.ts`. ADR-0131 D2 lists `bootstrapDeclaredSharingRules` among the retirements.

## Behavior-free pin

The full `@objectstack/plugin-security` suite was run before (base `0fea05fe3`) and after (`539010f0`). Both runs: 196 files, 4,150 tests, 4,105 passed, 45 skipped, 0 failed. Compared by (file, full test name), the two runs have the same set of keys and no status differs.

## Size

1,422 changed lines (+725 / −697) over 22 files, measured by `dispatch-gates`. That is under the 3,000 line of batch #310 item 7.

## Local gates (on `539010f0`)

- **Build:** `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-security...' --filter '@objectstack/plugin-auth...' build` exited 0.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` exited 0. That covers `tsc --noEmit`, the scripts program and `check:test-typecheck` for both packages.
- **Tests:** the `plugin-security` suite results are under "Behavior-free pin" above.
- **`dispatch-gates --ran`:** 69 families derived, 66 run with exit 0, 3 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. The five roster gates whose roster sits under a changed path also ran, and exited 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:auth-mount-ledger`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`.
- **The three NOT MEASURED (each exited 3, prerequisite refused):**
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` read every package's `dist/`, and only this diff's closure was built.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs an unshallowed clone. It is checker-health only.
- **Left to CI:** the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the workspace type-check lanes.

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/check-logger-receiver-detach.mjs:503` carries a control-fixture provenance comment naming `per-organization-catalog.ts`. It is a gate script, which this stage does not touch. It goes stale when 6c deletes the module. Carrier: stage 6c.
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` pins `per-organization-catalog.test.ts`. That test is not moved here: it exercises the retired seeders and goes with them.
